After surviving a single-target physical hit it counterattacks at once for the damage DEF mitigated (true damage).
Every active damage, heal or shield skill is cast a second time at once, at {MON_ECHO_POWER:pct} power.
Heals {MON_TIDE_REGEN:pct} of max HP at the start of each of its actions. Healing beyond max HP becomes a shield, up to {MON_TIDE_SHIELD_CAP:pct} of max HP.
Every hit it lands heals it for {MON_DRAIN_FRAC:pct} of the damage dealt.
Its fire damage ignores {MON_FIRE_PIERCE:pct} of the target's DEF or WIS and is never resisted by the target's element.
Acts twice in a row on each of its first {MON_DOUBLE_TURNS} turn(s) of a fight.
Drills cost 5% less energy per rank.
Monsters start runs with 10% higher base stats per rank.
+10% odds a run is attuned to its in-run chase tree.
Start each run with one extra skill point per rank.
Max HP in battle is HP x {MON_HP_PER_POINT}. Skills that scale with HP use max HP.

Physical damage. The basic attack hits for {BASIC_ATTACK_POWER} x the higher of STR and INT, and STR-scaled skills deal physical damage. Physical hits can be dodged (DEX) and the target's DEF reduces them.
Magical damage. INT-scaled skills deal magical damage, which cannot be dodged and which the target's WIS reduces. The basic attack uses INT instead of STR when INT is higher, and is then magical.
Magic defence: magical damage taken is multiplied by {MON_DEF_K} / ({MON_DEF_K} + WIS), so {MON_DEF_K} WIS halves it. WIS also sets the amount of WIS-scaled heals and shields.

Dodging physical hits. Dodge chance is {MON_EVADE_BASE:pct} plus {MON_EVADE_PER_DEX:pct} per point of DEX above the attacker's (minus when below), from 0 to {MON_EVADE_CAP:pct}. DEX also makes the unit's own physical hits harder to dodge. Magical hits cannot be dodged.
Dodges {evade:pct} of {foe}'s physical hits; {foe} dodges {foe_evade:pct} of the physical hits it takes
Physical defence: physical damage taken is multiplied by {MON_DEF_K} / ({MON_DEF_K} + DEF), so {MON_DEF_K} DEF halves it.

Turn speed. Each tick the action gauge fills by SPD (at least {MON_SPD_MIN}) and the unit acts each time it reaches {BATTLE_GAUGE}. SPD {SPD_REF} acts once per turn; twice the SPD acts twice as often.

Critical hits. Crit chance is {MON_CRIT_BASE:pct} plus {MON_CRIT_PER_LUK:pct} per LUK (plus crit chance effects), up to {MON_CRIT_CAP:pct}. A crit deals x{MON_CRIT_DMG} damage (plus crit damage effects). Physical and magical hits can both crit.
Now vs {foe}, before buffs and passives
Physical: DEX can dodge it, the target's DEF reduces it
Magical: cannot be dodged, the target's WIS reduces it
Hits for the amount; then a crit (LUK), the element (x{ELEMENT_STRONG_MULT} when strong, x{ELEMENT_WEAK_MULT} when weak) and the target's defence apply. Shields absorb it first.
Restores HP, never above max HP.
Absorbs damage before HP while it lasts. A new shield replaces a smaller one; shields do not add up.
Single-target enemy actions must target this unit while it lasts.
Raises a stat while it lasts: a trained stat by a share of its base value, crit chance and crit damage by the amount itself.
Lowers a stat while it lasts, by a share of its base value. A stat never drops below {STAT_FLOOR_FRAC:pct} of its base.
Raises a stat for the whole fight: a trained stat by a share of its base value (max HP raises current HP too), crit chance and crit damage by the amount itself.
One enemy: a taunting enemy if there is one, else a random one
The ally with the lowest share of max HP

At the start of each of its actions

Each trigger adds a stack, up to {EFFECT_STACK_CAP}; at the cap it renews the stack with the least time left instead
It or an ally is missing at least the HP it restores, so none is wasted (a heal too big for that: at or below {AI_HEAL_BELOW:pct} of max HP)
It or an ally is below {AI_SHIELD_BELOW:pct} of max HP
The target does not have this buff
An enemy does not have this debuff, and it lands on one that does not
Each action uses the first ready heal or shield whose condition holds, else the first ready other skill, in slot then node order; otherwise a basic attack

Lower every enemy's {stat} by {power:pct} for {duration} turns. Cooldown {cooldown}.
Dungeon: when its entropy gauge would vent, it gains a shield of {ENTROPY_CONVERT_SHIELD:pct} of max HP for {ENTROPY_CONVERT_TURNS} turns instead.
The boss raises a shield. Break it before it fades, or the boss heals and hits harder.
Adds join the fight. While one lives, the boss takes less damage. Killing the boss still wins.
The boss charges a strike on your whole team. Deal enough damage to it in time to interrupt.
The boss hits harder every turn until the fight ends.

Dungeon: builds up as a unit's free extra effects fire: +{ENTROPY_PER_TRIGGER} per triggered effect, +{ENTROPY_PER_ECHO} per echo and +{ENTROPY_PER_COUNTER} per counterattack. It drains {ENTROPY_DECAY} at the start of the unit's own action. At {ENTROPY_CAP} the gauge vents and empties, in turn: recoil, stun, then enrage.
The unit takes {ENTROPY_RECOIL_FRAC:pct} of its max HP as true damage (a shield absorbs it).
The unit loses {ENTROPY_STUN_GAUGE} of its action gauge and acts later.
Every enemy deals {ENTROPY_ENRAGE_FRAC:pct} more damage for {ENTROPY_ENRAGE_TURNS} turns.

Dungeon: from turn {start_turns} the arena corrupts one more level every {every_turns} turns, for both sides. Each level adds {CORRUPT_DMG_PER_LEVEL:pct} to all damage and cuts healing and shields by {CORRUPT_HEAL_PER_LEVEL:pct}, to no less than {CORRUPT_HEAL_FLOOR:pct}.
